fixed_source_calibration.provenance: Jozsa 2007 Tables 1 and 4; major-axis PA is the published reference normal PA minus 90 degrees modulo 180

estimator.pixel_acceptance: finite positive SoFiA-masked moment0 and finite moment1
estimator.ring_edges: midpoints of the frozen source radii, clipped to the declared support
estimator.side_estimator: unweighted median of signed deprojected circular speed per side and ring
estimator.variable_geometry_radius_solver: four deterministic fixed-point iterations initialized by sky radius
estimator.primary_score: mean absolute approaching-minus-receding ring-speed difference over common eligible rings
secondary_scores: fraction of common rings improved by variable geometry

comparison.control: fixed source inclination and major-axis PA
comparison.success_direction: candidate primary score lower than control

claim_boundary: Independent standard readout-calibration endpoint only. It cannot select a Tau q_R, parent morphology, dark-matter replacement, or Nature occupation.
